# The capture spec counts a landing cover's light partner as a second card

## Context

On `dev` at 0773ec79c6, `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/docs/CaptureExamples.spec.mjs` fails "the committed Grid/Table catalog selects a capture for every covered card". The capture selector returns 22 rows for 21 covered records, with `timeline-basic` twice. Every open pull request's unit check runs on its merge with `dev` and fails there. It was first seen on neo #21997 at d0fdd2f682, then reproduced on `dev` alone. A push to `dev` runs no unit job, so `dev` shows no red of its own.

## The Problem

Two merges crossed within two minutes, each green against the `dev` it saw. #21985 (Resolves #21933) captures every covered record without a recipe twice: its dark landing frame and its `-light` partner. #21996 (Resolves #21930) gave Grid & Table its first such record, `timeline-basic`, and rewrote this test to accept landing rows, counting one row per record id.

## The Architectural Reality

- `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs` `validateCaptureRecipes()`: a covered record without a recipe gets one landing entry per `PAIR_THEMES` scheme. The entries share the id: `variant: ''` with the dark themes, and `variant: '-light'` with the light ones.
- The test compares `rows.map(row => row.id)` with the covered records' ids, so a record with two rows breaks the equality.
- Records with a recipe (`grid-tree`, `grid-content-sized-rows`) still yield one row each.

Design authority: #21985's `PAIR_THEMES` loop in `validateCaptureRecipes()`, which captures a landing cover with its light partner.

## The Fix

The test compares the set of selected ids with the covered records, and checks that each landing record has exactly its dark and `-light` rows. The change is test-only; `captureExamples.mjs` stays as #21985 shipped it.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `CaptureExamples.spec.mjs` passes on `dev`. It still fails when a covered record has no row, and when a landing record lacks either variant.
- [ ] An open pull request's unit check is green on its merge ref again.

## Out of Scope

The capture behavior itself (#21985's pairing). Light partners for records with a recipe.
